parole.significato: screw, bolt, a threaded metal fastener
parole.testo: A Turkic borrowing, likely borrowed from Ottoman Turkish بورغی (burɣu, “screw, auger”).

parole.significato: bundle, a cloth tied up for carrying things other than cloths
parole.testo: From Turkic languages, in consequence of the Mongol pressure and again after the Ottoman territory gains from Ottoman Turkish بوغچه (boğça, bohça).
